title: CSE Assignment Builder
description: A browser-based tool to build and export CSE assignment PDFs — cover page, pseudo code, algorithm, flow chart, source code & output — all in one click.

title: Student Task Tracker
description: Student Task Manager is a simple and modern Android app that helps students organize tasks, assignments, exams, study schedules, and reminders in one place. It is designed to improve productivity, build consistent study habits, and make academic life more organized.
